purpose: Focused R2-06 semantic and boundedness gold. This is not the R2-09 formal N-05 performance run.

cases.name: detail_facet_breaks_overview_tie
cases.requirement: Two candidates may be indistinguishable at overview level; the candidate with matching same-Facet semantics must rank higher.
expected: matching detailed Facet candidate ranks above overview-only tie

cases.name: small_statement_evidence_breaks_overview_and_facet_tie
cases.requirement: A small number of important same-Facet Statements may determine similarity after overview and Facet ties.

cases.name: large_irrelevant_statement_count_has_no_volume_boost
cases.requirement: A large candidate with many irrelevant Statements must not outrank a smaller genuinely similar candidate merely because it has more Statements.
expected: per-source-query candidate Object contribution is deduplicated
Statement evidence contribution is capped at 3 items per candidate
Statement count beyond the cap adds no direct score

cases.name: canonical_facet_boundary_is_hard
cases.requirement: Facet and Statement evidence may compare only within the same canonical Facet.
expected: personality does not match values merely because vector proximity is high
facet-specific API never falls back to overview, another Facet, or object_overall

cases.name: generation_and_current_version_isolation
cases.requirement: All R2 component evidence comes from one resolved active generation while candidates remain current accepted Versions.
expected: object_overall does not appear in R2 evidence
generation payload mismatch is an integrity error
historical source remains compatible with current candidate scope

cases.name: bounded_work_contract
cases.requirement: Overall similarity work is structurally bounded independently of Object Statement count.
